background.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph used as a background plate for a vertical tower construction game, wide landscape 16:9. View almost straight ahead from street level, slight elevated perspective looking at a quiet European urban construction site. Vast clear pale blue sky with soft natural realistic cumulus clouds fills upper 75 percent. Only the bottom quarter contains distant detailed masonry apartment buildings at far left and far right, slightly softened by atmospheric haze, a low weathered brick boundary wall, realistic safety fence and distant construction materials. In bottom center leave a completely clear concrete foundation area and open sky all the way above it for a separately rendered tower. No building, crane, poles, wires or tree obstructing the central 45 percent of the composition. Bottom edge is a horizontal concrete apron across the entire image. Natural neutral late afternoon daylight from upper left, gentle soft shadows, restrained colors, fine photographic textures, professional architectural photography, 50mm lens with natural perspective, no exaggerated wide angle. Absolutely not cartoon, not illustration, not low-poly, not toy diorama, no text, no logos, no people, no UI. The skyline must stay low so the center is an open, clean playable area.

facades.prompt: Create a production game texture atlas of SIX photorealistic architectural facades in an exact 3-column by 2-row grid, no margins, no gutters, no text anywhere. Wide landscape image 2.16:1. Every panel a full rectangular single-story building facade seen perfectly straight on, flat orthographic front elevation, width to height about 1.44:1. Each facade completely fills its panel edge to edge, no sky, no ground, no neighboring buildings, no perspective. Consistent soft neutral daylight with realistic subtle recess shadows. All facades have fine natural weathering, physically believable wood/brick/stone, clear window reflections, recessed window frames, interior curtains, authentic architectural details. Top row left: honey oak cabin facade, two white-trim sash windows, weathered green wooden shutters, flower box with detailed tiny leaves. Top row middle: aged red brick facade, two arched windows, dark bronze metal frames, slim iron balcony rail and worn stone lintels. Top row right: contemporary office facade, pale concrete surround, three full height dark glass window bays, realistic sky reflections and slim black metal mullions. Bottom row left: elegant cream limestone facade with three arched windows, fine carved stone details, believable mortar, dark recessed interiors. Bottom row middle: cafe shop facade, muted dark green painted wood, detailed red and cream striped canvas awning, two shop windows with curtains and a narrow door, blank sign board with NO WORDS. Bottom row right: old warm ivory plaster and dark oak timber frame facade with a large authentic antique brass-rimmed clock at the center, Roman numerals on the clock allowed, weathered subtle surface detail. Architectural restoration survey photography quality, NOT cartoon, NOT illustration, NOT plastic, NOT miniature. Every panel is a rectangular wall texture suitable for mapping onto the front face of a 3D block.
